name: distance_rank
definition: One-based proximity rank; ties use arc ID.

name: heading_difference_deg
definition: Absolute movement/segment heading difference, degrees; 90 when invalid.

name: projection_fraction
definition: Clipped position along the directed segment, from 0 to 1.

name: displacement_m
definition: GPS displacement from preceding retained observation, metres; first=0.

name: heading_valid
definition: 1 when displacement >=3 m and 0<time gap<=30 s; otherwise 0.

name: dt_s
definition: Seconds since preceding retained observation; first=0.

name: speed_mps
definition: Displacement divided by positive time gap; first=0.

name: from_out_degree
definition: Outgoing nondegenerate directed arc count at candidate start node.

name: to_in_degree
definition: Incoming nondegenerate directed arc count at candidate end node.

name: from_in_degree
definition: Incoming nondegenerate directed arc count at candidate start node.

name: to_out_degree
definition: Outgoing nondegenerate directed arc count at candidate end node.

name: candidate_count
definition: Number of generated candidates for this GPS observation; no labels used.

name: distance_gap_to_nearest_m
definition: Candidate distance minus minimum candidate distance at the observation.

name: acceleration_mps2
definition: Change in consecutive gap-average speeds divided by current gap; 0 unless both gaps are in (0,30] s.
